_comment: Your model targets for ci.yml's quality gate. The floors (classification: roc_auc >= 0.5 and f1/recall/precision > 0; regression: r2 > 0) always apply; add stricter ones here, e.g. min: {roc_auc: 0.95, recall_positive: 0.8} for classification, or min: {r2: 0.7} and max: {rmse: 12.5} for regression. enforce=false downgrades failures to warnings. `min` was seeded from this run's metric minus a safety margin (0.05; 0.10 for r2) so a clearly worse retrain fails CI -- raise it as the model improves.
